ladder.subject: large brown wolf spider

contexts.safe: An old wooden garden shed with dusty shelves, clay pots, and garden tools under soft daylight. Wide shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.
contexts.enter: A large brown wolf spider crawls slowly onto the bottom shelf from behind a clay pot.
contexts.exit: The large brown wolf spider crawls back behind the clay pot and disappears.

levels.state: A large brown wolf spider sits quietly on the bottom wooden shelf of the garden shed. Wide shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.
levels.up: A large brown wolf spider crawls slowly onto the bottom shelf from behind a clay pot.
levels.down: The large brown wolf spider crawls back behind the clay pot and disappears.
holds: The large brown wolf spider shifts its legs slightly on the dusty wood.
The large brown wolf spider remains still on the shelf under the daylight.

levels.state: A large brown wolf spider sits on a wooden trowel handle on the middle shelf of the garden shed. Medium shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.
levels.up: The large brown wolf spider crawls up the wooden support beam to the middle shelf.
levels.down: The large brown wolf spider crawls down the wooden support beam to the bottom shelf.
holds: The large brown wolf spider adjusts its position on the wooden handle.
The large brown wolf spider turns slowly on the handle of the trowel.

levels.state: A large brown wolf spider sits on the rim of a red clay pot on the workbench. Medium close-up shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.
levels.up: The large brown wolf spider crawls from the shelf onto the workbench and climbs the clay pot.
levels.down: The large brown wolf spider crawls down the clay pot back onto the middle shelf.
holds: The large brown wolf spider taps its front legs on the clay rim.
The large brown wolf spider rests quietly on the curved edge of the pot.

levels.state: A large brown wolf spider sits on a gardening glove resting on the workbench. Close-up shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.
levels.up: The large brown wolf spider crawls from the clay pot onto the fabric of the gardening glove.
levels.down: The large brown wolf spider crawls off the gardening glove back onto the clay pot.
holds: The large brown wolf spider moves slowly across the fingers of the glove.
The large brown wolf spider pauses on the wrist strap of the glove.

levels.state: A large brown wolf spider sits on the edge of the workbench right next to the camera lens. Extreme close-up shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.
levels.up: The large brown wolf spider crawls to the very edge of the workbench near the camera.
levels.down: The large brown wolf spider crawls back toward the center of the workbench.
holds: The large brown wolf spider moves its pedipalps slowly in front of the lens.
The large brown wolf spider stands still at the edge of the wood.

contexts.safe: A bright living room with a fabric sofa, a wooden coffee table, and a green houseplant in the corner. Wide shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.
contexts.enter: A large brown wolf spider crawls slowly onto the baseboard near the green houseplant.
contexts.exit: The large brown wolf spider crawls behind the baseboard and out of view.

levels.state: A large brown wolf spider rests on the baseboard in the corner of the living room. Wide shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.
levels.up: A large brown wolf spider crawls slowly onto the baseboard near the green houseplant.
levels.down: The large brown wolf spider crawls behind the baseboard and out of view.
holds: The large brown wolf spider remains still against the white paint of the baseboard.
The large brown wolf spider shifts its position slightly on the wood trim.

levels.state: A large brown wolf spider sits on the lower leaf of the green houseplant. Medium shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.
levels.up: The large brown wolf spider climbs up the stem to the lower leaf of the plant.
levels.down: The large brown wolf spider climbs down the stem back to the baseboard.
holds: The large brown wolf spider balances on the wide green leaf.
The large brown wolf spider crawls slowly to the center of the leaf.

levels.state: A large brown wolf spider sits on the wooden surface of the coffee table. Medium close-up shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.
levels.up: The large brown wolf spider crawls from the plant pot onto the wooden coffee table.
levels.down: The large brown wolf spider crawls off the coffee table back to the plant pot.
holds: The large brown wolf spider walks slowly across the polished wood grain.
The large brown wolf spider pauses near a ceramic coaster on the table.

levels.state: A large brown wolf spider sits on the armrest of the fabric sofa. Close-up shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.
